mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_name FROM users u JOIN role r ON JSON_CONTAINS(u.role, CAST(r.id AS CHAR)) JOIN permission p ON JSON_CONTAINS(r.permissions, CAST(p.id AS CHAR)) WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.status = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users u SET u.password = MD5(CONCAT( SUBSTRING(MD5(username), 1, 6), #{newPassword}, SUBSTRING(MD5(username), LENGTH(MD5(username)) - 2, 3) )) WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.password = MD5(CONCAT( SUBSTRING(MD5(username), 1, 6), #{oldPassword}, SUBSTRING(MD5(username), LENGTH(MD5(username)) - 2, 3) ))
